items.title: Rebuild Missing Files report: add Missing/Archive Issue filter badges + Show all
items.why: Director's own ask: match the clickable filter-badge convention this app already uses on other reports (Missing Masters, Stats Report) instead of one long undifferentiated table.
items.prompt:
Add the same clickable filter-badge convention this app already uses elsewhere (Missing Masters' mmSummaryBadges/mmStatusFilter, Stats Report's statsIssuesBadges) to Rebuild Missing Files' Step 2 report -- director's own explicit ask: "like all the other reports." Don't invent a new filter UI, copy the established one. REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATION (copy this shape exactly): `web/public/missing-masters-app.js`'s `mmRenderSummaryBadges` -- a `.summary-badges` container of `.badge.badge--clickable` pills, one per category with a live count, toggle-on-click (click active pill again to clear), plus a `.badge--show-all` pill that's active when no filter is set. Filtering itself is a plain array `.filter()` against a module-level `xFilter` variable, re-rendering the list on every click. This app already has the `.summary-badges`/`.badge`/`.badge--clickable`/`.badge--filter-active`/`.badge--show-all` CSS classes -- reuse them, don't add new ones. SCOPE for Rebuild Missing Files (`web/public/rebuild-missing-app.js`, `web/public/index.html`'s Step 2 report section): 1. Add a `
` near the existing stat row / `rmfSummaryCallout` (Step 2, before the table). 2. Two categories, matching `rmfState.rows`' own existing `kind` field: **Missing** (`kind === 'missing'`) and **Archive Issue** (`kind === 'archive-missing'`) -- use plain-language-writer for the exact badge label wording (e.g. is "Archive Issue" or "Archive Not Found" clearer given this row state already shows '⚠️ Archive not found on disk' inline? check the existing row copy before picking a badge label, keep them consistent) plus a **Show all** pill. 3. A module-level `rmfKindFilter` (null | 'missing' | 'archive-missing'), same toggle-on-click behavior as `mmStatusFilter`. 4. Filter the actual table body render (wherever `rmfRenderRows` currently iterates `rmfState.rows`) by `rmfKindFilter` when set, same as `mmRenderMasterList` does. 5. Counts must reflect the LIVE row set at render time (recompute from `rmfState.rows`, not a stale snapshot) -- rows drop out of `rmfState.rows` as they're fixed (Extract/Download Archive success), so badge counts need to shrink to match, same as `rmfStatFiles`/`rmfStatMods` already do elsewhere in this file. 6. If the active filter's own category count reaches 0 (everything in it just got fixed), reset to "Show all" automatically rather than leaving the user staring at an empty table with an active filter that no longer means anything -- check whether Missing Masters' own version already handles this edge case (its own empty-state message suggests it might not; use your own judgment on the right UX here if it doesn't, and flag if you make a judgment call). VERIFY live: real scan with both missing-file and archive-not-found rows present, click each badge and confirm the table filters correctly, click Show all to clear, fix something via Extract/Download Archive and confirm the badge counts update live. Handoff with what you tested.
